title: cURL Inspector
privacy: Local parsing only. Paste inside this tool, never into launcher search. No request, shell, file access or automatic clipboard capture.
hint: POSIX quotes and backslash continuations; curl URL, -X, -H, -d, --data-raw, --url and -I only. Maximum 100,000 characters. Values stay hidden until explicitly shown.
copy.ok: Copied in full without recording in Hiven history.
copy.failed: Could not copy without history recording. No ordinary-copy fallback was used.
headers.hint: Explicit header values, plus the data content type default. Transport-generated headers are not simulated.
error.limit: Input exceeds 100,000 characters. It is preserved and was not truncated.
error.quote: Unclosed quote or trailing backslash. Check POSIX quoting.
error.shell: Shell expansion, operators or multiple commands are unsupported. Nothing is executed. Quote literal URL punctuation; use a backslash for line continuation.
error.command: The command must start with curl, without aliases, assignments or wrappers.
error.option: Unsupported option. Only -X/--request, -H/--header, -d/--data, --data-raw, --url and -I/--head are accepted. No partial request is shown.
error.value: An option is missing its value.
error.file: @file input is unsupported; no file is read. Use literal data or --data-raw for a literal @ prefix.
error.url: Exactly one valid HTTP or HTTPS URL is required.
error.multiple: Multiple URLs are unsupported. Split the command before parsing.
error.header: Headers must use Name: value with a nonempty value and no line breaks. Header removal and empty-header shorthand are unsupported.
error.method: Explicit method must contain letters only and is preserved exactly.
error.conflict: Repeated methods or combining --head with data or an explicit method is unsupported.
error.glob: URL globbing is unsupported. Use one literal URL without brace or range expansion.
cut.hint: Use Copy full original to copy without Hiven history; cut is disabled.
